name: getRouteInformation
description:
Retrieves Route Information records from EIM → Route Information (RoutInfo.aspx).
The user can search routes by route code (exact match) or route name (partial match). If the user requests a full list (e.g., “show all routes,” “return all,” “list available routes,” or "what are the existing routes"), the tool triggers the Show All action and returns all available Route records from the results grid.

basic.name: getRouteInformation
basic.description:
Retrieves Route Information records from EIM → Route Information (RoutInfo.aspx).
The user can search routes by route code (exact match) or route name (partial match). If the user requests a full list (e.g., “show all routes,” “return all,” “list available routes,” or "what are the existing routes"), the tool triggers the Show All action and returns all available Route records from the results grid.

args.name: routeCode
args.description:
Route code to search for (e.g., "000001"). Searches by RT_ID (exact match).
Example: "000003"

args.name: routeName
args.description:
Route name (or partial name) to search for (e.g., "Expressway", "Central"). Searches by RT_NAME and supports partial match.
Example: "Express"

args.name: returnAll
args.description:
When user asks to return all/available/existing routes, set this to one of:
"true", "yes", "all", "1", "showall", "returnall", "available", "existing", "list".
Triggers Show All (ctl00$body$ContentSearch$butAll) and returns every grid row.

args.name: pageNumber
args.description: Specific page number to fetch when not auto-fetching all pages. Default = "1".

args.name: pageSize
args.description: Number of records per page to request from grid. Server may cap this. Default = "100".

args.name: autoFetchAllPages
args.description: Controls whether transformer automatically loops through all pages. Defaults to true when returnAll is used.

args.name: maxPages
args.description: Safety limit to prevent infinite paging loops. Default "50".
